#| output: asis

import os
import re
from datetime import datetime
from glob import glob
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

def front_matter(path):
    return yaml.safe_load(re.split(r"(?m)^---\s*$", path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), maxsplit=2)[1])

def item_date(item):
    value = item.get("date") or item.get("citation", {}).get("issued")
    for fmt in ("%m/%d/%Y", "%Y-%m-%d", "%Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(str(value), fmt)
        except ValueError:
            pass
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported date: {value}")

def markdown(text):
    text = re.sub(r"([\\`*_{}\[\]<>])", r"\\\1", str(text))
    # Keep Hangul in venue names legible without changing the other fonts.
    return re.sub(r"[\uac00-\ud7a3]+", r"`{\\cvhangul \g<0>}`{=latex}", text)

def author_names(authors):
    if not isinstance(authors, list):
        authors = [authors]
    return [author["name"] if isinstance(author, dict) else author for author in authors]

def format_authors(authors):
    return ", ".join(markdown(name).replace("Hirofumi Shiba", "**Hirofumi Shiba**")
                     for name in author_names(authors))

# Use the Web listing's file selection as well as the papers' YAML metadata.
project_dir = os.environ.get("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR")
working_dir = Path.cwd().resolve()
candidates = ([Path(project_dir).resolve()] if project_dir else []) + [working_dir, *working_dir.parents]
root = next((path for path in candidates
             if (path / "_quarto.yml").is_file() and (path / "static/CV/cv.qmd").is_file()), None)
if root is None:
    raise FileNotFoundError("CV project root not found. Run Quarto from the repository or static/CV directory.")
web_page = root / "static/Publications.qmd"
listing = next(item for item in front_matter(web_page)["listing"] if item["id"] == "citable-listing")
paths = sorted({Path(path).resolve() for pattern in listing["contents"]
                for path in glob(str(web_page.parent / pattern), recursive=True)})
papers = [front_matter(path) for path in paths]
papers = [paper for paper in papers if not paper.get("draft", False)]

for paper in sorted(papers, key=item_date, reverse=True):
    citation = paper["citation"]
    authors = format_authors(paper["author"])
    venue = (paper.get("container-title-short") or citation.get("container-title-short")
             or paper.get("container-title") or citation.get("container-title"))
    title = markdown(paper["title"])
    url = citation.get("url") or paper.get("pub", {}).get("arxiv-url")
    if url:
        title = f"[{title}](<{url}>)"
    entry = f"{authors} ({markdown(citation['issued'])}). {title}."
    if venue:
        entry += f" *{markdown(venue)}*."
    print(f"1. {entry}\n")
```

#| output: asis

from fnmatch import fnmatchcase
from urllib.parse import quote, urljoin

cv_page = root / "static/CV/cv.qmd"
cv_listings = {item["id"]: item for item in front_matter(cv_page)["listing"]}
site_url = yaml.safe_load((root / "_quarto.yml").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["website"]["site-url"]

def matches_field(item, field, patterns):
    values = author_names(item.get(field, [])) if field == "author" else item.get(field, [])
    values = values if isinstance(values, list) else [values]
    patterns = patterns if isinstance(patterns, list) else [patterns]
    for pattern in patterns:
        # Match the listing's glob alternatives, e.g. {Draft Draft,司馬 博文}.
        alternatives = pattern[1:-1].split(",") if pattern.startswith("{") and pattern.endswith("}") else [pattern]
        if any(fnmatchcase(str(value), alternative) for value in values for alternative in alternatives):
            return True
    return False

def presentation_items(listing_id):
    listing = cv_listings[listing_id]
    paths = set()
    for pattern in listing["contents"]:
        for match in glob(str(cv_page.parent / pattern), recursive=True):
            path = Path(match)
            candidates = path.rglob("*.qmd") if path.is_dir() else [path]
            paths.update(candidate.resolve() for candidate in candidates
                         if candidate.suffix == ".qmd" and not candidate.name.startswith(("_", ".")))
    if not paths:
        raise ValueError(f"No source files found for {listing_id}")
    items = []
    for path in sorted(paths):
        item = front_matter(path)
        if item.get("draft", False):
            continue
        if not all(matches_field(item, field, pattern) for field, pattern in listing.get("include", {}).items()):
            continue
        if any(matches_field(item, field, pattern) for field, pattern in listing.get("exclude", {}).items()):
            continue
        items.append((item, path))
    return sorted(items, key=lambda pair: item_date(pair[0]), reverse=True)

def print_presentations(listing_id, kind):
    for item, path in presentation_items(listing_id):
        event = item[kind]
        title = item["title"] + (f": {item['subtitle']}" if item.get("subtitle") else "")
        # Absolute links to the same Details pages used by the HTML listing.
        url = urljoin(site_url.rstrip("/") + "/", quote(path.relative_to(root).with_suffix(".html").as_posix()))
        entry = f"{item_date(item):%Y-%m-%d}."
        if event.get("time"):
            entry += f" ({markdown(event['time'])})"
        entry += f" {format_authors(item['author'])}. [{markdown(title)}](<{url}>)."
        if event.get("event-title"):
            venue = markdown(event["event-title"])
            if event.get("event-url"):
                venue = f"[{venue}](<{event['event-url']}>)"
            entry += f" *{venue}*."
        if event.get("place"):
            entry += f" {markdown(event['place'])}."
        if event.get("note"):
            entry += f" ({markdown(event['note'])})"
        print(f"1. {entry}\n")

print_presentations("talk-listing", "slide")
```
